title: Genesis 17:19 — Sarah will bear a son, Isaac (header reads 18:19)
summary: Genesis 17:19: God tells Abraham that Sarah his wife will bear him a son named Isaac, with whom He will establish His everlasting covenant. The English header on the slide reads 'Genesis 18:19' while the Hebrew header reads בראשית יז:יט (17:19), and the verse shown is Genesis 17:19. 'God' is blue, red and yellow; Sarah magenta; 'son', Isaac, 'him' and 'his' red.

text.text: 19 But God said, “No, but Sarah your wife will bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac; and I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.

keywords: Sarah shall bear thee a son
